title: yencoding-multi integration test: wrong CRC value in comment at line 371
description: yencoding-multi/tests/integration.rs:371 — The comment says 'three_parts_in_order test (hardcoded Python-derived CRC 0xb095_e0e9)' but the actual EXPECTED_CRC constant is 0xb43b1251 (matching the Python oracle at line 74). The comment references the wrong hex value. Fix: change 0xb095_e0e9 to 0xb43b1251 in the comment on line 371.
